title: Practice 2: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Том был ___ (окружный) шерифом.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «шерифом»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This should become standard practice.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «практикой»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том не обладает ___ (лидерский) качествами.
exercises.prompt: Tom doesn't have what it takes to be a good leader.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «качествами»: instrumental plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: For more information, please visit our website.
